company.name: Getaround
company.shortDescription: Getaround is a peer-to-peer car sharing marketplace that enables car owners to rent out their cars.
company.description: Getaround empowers users to instantly rent and drive great cars shared by people in their city. Cars can be rented by the hour, or the day, with a $1M insurance policy and 24/7 roadside assistance included. By using its app, people skip the lines and paperwork at traditional rental car counters, and the hassle of buying and maintaining a car. Powered by Getaround ConnectTM, the patented connected car technology, Getaround creates a fun and safe carsharing experience is without the need to meet the car owner, carry an access card, or coordinate picking up a car key. People share everything from a Prius to a Tesla and earn thousands in extra income each year, offsetting the high cost of car ownership while also making a positive impact on the environment.

aiResearchSummary.text: Getaround is focusing on developing vehicle access control services and platforms. This involves receiving vehicle reservations from wireless communication devices, authenticating these reservations, and providing access to vehicles post-authentication. These innovations aim to streamline the process of renting out cars by ensuring secure and efficient access control, aligning with Getaround's mission as a peer-to-peer car sharing marketplace.
